'''House Taneel''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], one of the [[Ancient Houses]] of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region. House Taneel hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neelanon/Legends|Neelanon]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], and possessed the worlds of [[Crovna]] and [[Adoris]]. A scion of the house, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]], represented the Senex sector in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
===Founding and early history===
[[File:SenexJuvex.jpg|left|200px|thumb|House Taneel, alongside sixteen other families from the Core, colonized the Senex-Juvex region soon after the Ruusan Reformations.]]
House Taneel originated as a wealthy family within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], existing as of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. House Taneel was one of seventeen families who joined the shipping magnate [[Thull Vandron]] in eschewing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of 1000 BBY. Vandron opposed the centralization of power, and when his ideas for the Reformations were denied he gathered the seventeen families to travel via secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to a cluster of worlds at the bright [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] which became known as [[Thull's Shroud/Legends|Thull's Shroud]].<ref name="TEA" />

This region became known as the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]], and the seventeen [[Ancient Houses]] which followed Vandron began to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] the region, subjugating native [[Species/Legends|species]] in the process. House Taneel became one of the nine houses to colonize the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], claiming<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Neelanon">{{CSWECite|II|367|Neelanon}}</ref> [[Neelanon/Legends|Neelanon]] as their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The house also possessed the urban world [[Crovna]], known for its [[Museum/Legends|museums]] and auction houses, as well as the world [[Adoris]], home of the famous [[Tooka/Legends|tooka]]. Taneel nobles were often picked to negotiate with outsiders, which was seen as more of an insult than an honor.<ref name="TEA" />

===Late Republic===
For [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] the houses existed in relative isolation until the [[Fourth Nantama Synod]], when the Ancient Houses opened up [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] relations with the Republic. Neelanon was named the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Senex sector, though that status was purely for Republic administrative matters and meant little to the sector's internal affairs. The Senex and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sectors]] also began to send [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], with the house's<ref name="TEA" /> [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]] serving in that role for the Senex sector<ref name="DB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

[[File:TerrTaneel.jpg|200px|right|thumb|Terr Taneel, a member of House Taneel, represented the Senex sector in the Galactic Senate.]]

By the last centuries of the Republic' existence, House Taneel was considered one of the more progressive houses of the sector,<ref name="TEA" /> with Terr Taneel being remarkably progressive<ref name="DB" /> and an idealist who believed she was above the squabbling of the Senex [[Lord/Legends|Lords]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> Taneel served on the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], a handpicked group of Senators close to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> and was a member of the [[Delegation of 2000]], a group concerned with Palpatine's reforms of centralization.<ref name="DB" />

Around this same [[Time/Legends|time]], Terr Taneel was being courted by [[Són Halliikeenovich]],<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> a member of the noble [[House Halliikeenovich]] of [[Dramassia]]&mdash;a family derisively called "peddler princes" by some individuals on the Taneel homeworld Neelanon.<ref name="TEA" /> Halliikeenovich hoped to strengthen both of their houses<ref name="SWCTP" /> and establish a stronger connection between his<ref name="CSWE Halliikeenovich">{{CSWECite|II|10|Halliikeenovich, Són}}</ref> lesser<ref name="SWCTP" /> noble house and those of the Senex sector.<ref name="CSWE Halliikeenovich" /> To this end, Halliikeenovich attended a showing of the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]'' with Taneel at [[Coruscant]]'s [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] not long after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in 19 BBY.<ref name="ROTS date" />

==Behind the scenes==
House Taneel, via Terr Taneel, first appeared in the novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="LoE" /> and released on [[January 25]], [[2005]].<ref name="LoE release">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=18222|text=James Luceno}}</ref> Terr Taneel was not identified as a member of a noble house until the release of ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''<ref name="SWCTP" /> on [[October 21]] of that same year.<ref name="SWCTP release">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20050817.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels''}}</ref> The house's name and backstory was identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA" /> and released on [[September 13]], [[2011]].<ref name="TEA release">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref>
